wu: Goal Race: Write 3 goals on sticky notes, stick them on the board, and race to match them with reasons (e.g., 'I want to learn English because...').
wuAlt: Goal Charades: Act out goals (e.g., 'study', 'exercise') for others to guess and say the reason.
Goal Bingo: Call out goals and reasons; students mark off matching squares.
pres: Show a New Year resolution video clip; model sentences like 'I want to improve my English because I need it for university' and 'I will try to study 30 minutes daily' with flashcards of goals and steps.
presAlt: Use a goal-setting infographic to highlight 'would like to + verb' (e.g., 'I would like to join a club') and 'plan to + verb' (e.g., 'I plan to read books').
Role-play a conversation between two friends discussing resolutions, drilling target language.
prac: Goal Steps Relay: In pairs, write a goal and 3 steps on paper, then pass to another pair to add reasons; check for correct use of 'I will try...' and 'because'.
pracAlt: Goal Sort: Categorize goals into 'study', 'health', 'hobby' using flashcards, then make sentences.
Goal Chain: Each student adds one step to a class resolution chain, using 'plan to'.
ls: Listen to a podcast clip about New Year goals; students complete a table with 'Goal', 'Reason', and 'Step' to check comprehension.
re: Goal Jump: Call out a goal (e.g., 'exercise'); students jump if they agree, squat if they disagree, then switch sides for debate practice.
prod: Two-Corners Debate: Label corners 'agree' and 'disagree' with 'New Year resolutions help people'; students debate with reasons like 'I think they help because...' then switch sides.
rw: Read a short article on SMART goals; write a 60-word email to a friend outlining one personal resolution with steps using 'I will try...' and 'because'.
st: Read a story about a teen achieving a resolution; end with the goodbye routine: 'Today we learned how to talk about goals with reasons—great job, thank you!'
g: Pairs write goals and steps, pass to others to add reasons.
Act out goals for others to guess and state reasons.
Jump/squat to agree/disagree with resolutions, then debate.
Match called-out goals with reasons on bingo cards.
Add steps to a class resolution chain using 'plan to'.
diff: Fast finishers: Write a second resolution with 3 steps in a paragraph.
Support: Use sentence frames like 'I want to... because... I will try to...'.
hw: Find a video about New Year goals and summarise in 3 sentences.
Write a 70-word paragraph about your biggest resolution and why.
Interview a family member about their goals and report back.
tip: Encourage students to link goals to local events like Independence Day to make language relevant and culturally connected.
